entities.name: CoaBC-like query
observations: 409-aa sequence; best reviewed homologs are CoaBC bifunctional proteins with 47–50% identity and 96–98% query coverage (query_protein homology output).
Likely catalyzes phosphopantothenate–cysteine ligase and phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase reactions in coenzyme A biosynthesis; assignment is homology-based, not direct assay evidence.
Sequence Pfam hits: Flavoprotein PF02441 at residues 3–176 and DFP PF04127 at residues 186–400.

entities.name: Coenzyme A biosynthesis
observations: Reviewed CoaBC homolog annotations place the protein in the pantothenate-to-CoA pathway, catalyzing steps 2 and 3 of five.

entities.name: CoaBC ligase step
observations: Reference reaction: (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate + L-cysteine + CTP → N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + CMP + diphosphate + H+ (Rhea RHEA:19397).

entities.name: CoaBC decarboxylase step
observations: Reference reaction: N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + H+ → (R)-4'-phosphopantetheine + CO2 (Rhea RHEA:16793).
